prior_art_relation: Previous RFM/kernel mixtures, Jacobian forests/boosting, and offset logistic combiners exist. This study newly adds an explicit squared error-correlation penalty against crossfitted anchored residuals, with a matched lambda0 control and nested fusion of all label logits.
reference_scope: Inspired by negative-correlation learning. The fixed-anchor squared-correlation objective here is our classical adaptation, not a reproduction of Liu and Yao's jointly trained neural objective or Ganin et al.'s domain adversary.
